iron_lung.name: Iron Lung
iron_lung.description: Every @term(health_cost), including an @kw(empower) cost, is paid from your @term(stoneskin) first, at 2 @kw(stoneskin) per @term(health).

ember_lens.name: Brightglass Lens
ember_lens.description: Your @kw(ranged) attacks against enemies in @term(illuminate) gain +1 @kw(chain).

pilgrim_boots.name: Pilgrim Boots
pilgrim_boots.description: Gain 1 more @kw(movement) each turn. Moving leaves radius-1 @term(illuminate) for 2 turns on tiles you enter, unless the card attacks. @kw(blink) lights both ends.

mirror_shard.name: Mirror Shard
mirror_shard.description: When your @term(illusion) is destroyed, it shatters, dealing 3 damage to each enemy next to it.

coffin_nails.name: Coffin Nails
coffin_nails.description: When an enemy attack hits your @term(block) and deals no @term(health) damage, the attacker gains @term(bleed) 1.

reinforced_shield.name: Reinforced Shield
reinforced_shield.description: While you have @term(stoneskin), cards that grant @term(block) grant 3 more.

iron_buckler.name: Iron Buckler
iron_buckler.description: At the start of your turn, keep up to 3 of your @term(block).

flint_edge.name: Flint Edge
flint_edge.description: Your @kw(melee) attacks @kw(surface_consume) the @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) under their target to deal 3 more damage.

static_soles.name: Static Soles
static_soles.description: Your first @kw(move) or @kw(blink) each turn leaves @term(surface_electrified) at its origin and grants @term(vision) 1 for 2 turns.

mossbound_wraps.name: Mossbound Wraps
mossbound_wraps.description: The first Earth card you play while you have @icon(block) each turn grants @icon(stoneskin) {0.reward0.amount}.

tailwind_fletching.name: Tailwind Fletching
tailwind_fletching.description: Your @kw(element_air) @kw(push) and @kw(pull) deal 1 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.

frost_prism.name: Shatterglass Prism
frost_prism.description: When you kill a @term(freeze|Frozen) enemy with an attack, leave @term(surface_rubble) on its tile and each tile next to it.

gale_tabi.name: Gale Tabi
gale_tabi.description: After you @kw(blink), your next attack this turn deals 1 more damage per tile blinked, up to 4 more. A later @kw(blink) replaces it.

anchor_chain.name: Anchor Chain
anchor_chain.description: While you have @term(block), your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) deal 2 more damage and move targets 1 tile farther.

venom_signet.name: Quarry Signet
venom_signet.description: Enemies standing on @term(surface_rubble) take 1 more damage from everything: attacks, @kw(collision), @term(surface_fire) and @kw(retaliate).

thawing_charm.name: Thawing Charm
thawing_charm.description: Excess healing becomes @term(stoneskin), up to 8 each turn. It also creates radius-1 @term(illuminate) on you for 2 turns, once per turn.

ember_siphon.name: Ember Siphon
ember_siphon.description: When an enemy dies on @term(surface_fire), @kw(surface_fire) spreads to each tile next to it without @kw(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified).

bloodglass_knife.name: Bloodglass Knife
bloodglass_knife.description: While you are at half @term(health) or less with no @term(block) or @term(stoneskin), your attacks deal 7 more damage.

cold_mirror.name: Cold Mirror
cold_mirror.description: When you @term(freeze) an enemy while you have 4 or more @term(block), trade all your @kw(block) for 1 @term(frost_armor) layer per 4, up to 2.

thunder_relay.name: Thunder Relay
thunder_relay.description: Your @kw(chain) attacks can swap their first and last enemy targets if both survive.

thornmail_brooch.name: Faultline Brooch
thornmail_brooch.description: Your single-target @kw(melee) can spend 4 @term(stoneskin) to strike a cross instead, leaving @term(surface_rubble) on it.

vaulting_sigil.name: Vaulting Sigil
vaulting_sigil.description: Your @kw(move) can pass through enemies, but not end on one. Each enemy you pass through suffers @kw(stagger) 2.

obsidian_heart.name: Obsidian Heart
obsidian_heart.description: At the start of combat, @kw(draw) 1 fewer card. At the end of your turn, convert all your @term(block) into @term(stoneskin).

storm_crown.name: Storm Crown
storm_crown.description: Your @kw(chain) attacks rebound: after the last hop, the bolt travels back along its route, hitting each enemy again for half damage, rounded down.

phoenix_ember.name: Phoenix Ember
phoenix_ember.description: Gain 1 @term(defiance). When @kw(defiance) saves you, @kw(dispel_umbra) 2, place @term(surface_fire) under every enemy, @kw(draw) 3 and gain 3 @term(card_play|Card Plays).

worldroot_idol.name: Worldroot Idol
worldroot_idol.description: While you stand on @term(surface_rubble), your @kw(melee) and @kw(ranged) attacks can strike from any connected @kw(surface_rubble) tile, @kw(surface_consume|Expending) it. The game picks the tile.

cinderbrand_tongs.name: Cinderbrand Tongs
cinderbrand_tongs.description: Your first card each turn to create new @icon(surface_fire) also creates @icon(illuminate) 1 @icon(time) 2 at its target.

rimecatcher_vial.name: Rimecatcher Vial
rimecatcher_vial.description: When your @term(element_ice) attack @term(freeze|Freezes) an enemy on @term(surface_ice), you can spill that @term(surface_ice) onto a tile next to it.

ion_spool.name: Ion Spool
ion_spool.description: The first @icon(element_lightning) attack each turn to conduct through {threshold}+ surface tiles grants @icon(draw) {0.reward0.amount}.

updraft_bottle.name: Updraft Bottle
updraft_bottle.description: Your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) can carry the @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) under the target along with it.

basalt_calendar.name: Basalt Kiln
basalt_calendar.description: Your @kw(detonate) can @kw(surface_consume) @term(surface_rubble) instead of @term(surface_fire), leaving @kw(surface_fire) on the @kw(surface_consume|Expended) tiles.

coalheart_crucible.name: Stormcoal Crucible
coalheart_crucible.description: @term(surface_fire) also conducts @kw(element_lightning). @kw(element_lightning) that conducts through @kw(surface_fire) @kw(surface_consume|Expends) it.

voltaic_tuning_fork.name: Stormglass Beacon
voltaic_tuning_fork.description: The first @icon(chain) attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} beneath every enemy it hits.

tectonic_abacus.name: Captured Noon
tectonic_abacus.description: While 3 or more @term(illuminate|Lights) are active, @kw(umbra|the Umbra) is 1 stage lower; with 6 or more, 2 stages lower.

overflow_censer.name: Overflow Censer
overflow_censer.description: When you place @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) over a different one, it also spreads to each tile next to it that has none.

black_sun_dial.name: Black Sun Dial
black_sun_dial.description: Store up to 3 @kw(surface_consume|Expended) ground tiles. Your next attack releases them: +2 damage each. @term(surface_fire): @kw(surface_fire) beneath. @term(surface_ice): @term(chilled). @term(surface_electrified): @term(shock). @term(surface_rubble): @kw(stagger) 2.

duelist_whetstone.name: Duelist Whetstone
duelist_whetstone.description: Attacks on cards that also @kw(move) or @kw(blink) deal 1 more damage per tile you moved this turn, up to 3 more.

hollow_die.name: Open-Eyed Pin
hollow_die.description: When a card grants @icon(vision) or @icon(truesight), create @icon(illuminate) {0.reward0.radius} at you matching that effect's @icon(time).

chorus_mask.name: Chorus Mask
chorus_mask.description: A card whose element differs from the last card you played this turn deals 2 more damage and grants 2 more @term(block).

hourglass_splinter.name: Hourglass Splinter
hourglass_splinter.description: When you play a card that costs 6 or more @term(time), @kw(quicken) 2.

widow_thread.name: Widow Thread
widow_thread.description: While you have an @term(illusion), your attacks apply +1 @term(expose).

funeral_bell.name: Funeral Bell
funeral_bell.description: When an enemy dies with 2 or more different statuses, such as @term(bleed) and @term(expose), each enemy next to it gains them.

bloodmoon_chalice.name: Bloodmoon Chalice
bloodmoon_chalice.description: When you lose @term(health) during your turn, your next attack this turn deals 2 more damage per @kw(health) lost, up to 8 more.

moonless_compass.name: Moonless Compass
moonless_compass.description: Once per combat, play separate @icon(move)/@icon(blink) and @icon(illuminate)/@icon(vision)/@icon(truesight) cards in one turn to gain @icon(stoneskin) {0.reward0.amount} and @icon(card_play) {0.reward1.amount}.

fivefold_knot.name: Fivefold Knot
fivefold_knot.description: Each element you play this combat ties a knot. 3 knots: your attacks @kw(pierce). 4: also @kw(chain) 1. 5: every card grants 3 @term(block).

borrowed_hourglass.name: Borrowed Hourglass
borrowed_hourglass.description: The first time each combat you end your turn with a @term(card_play) unused, take another turn at once. This turn's @term(time) is added to it.

dawnbrand_filament.name: Dawnbrand Filament
dawnbrand_filament.description: The first direct attack each turn creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} at its target.

briar_winch.name: Quarry Winch
briar_winch.description: Your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) can @kw(surface_consume) @term(surface_rubble) under an enemy to move it in any of the 4 directions.

hourglass_awl.name: Hourglass Awl
hourglass_awl.description: Attacks on cards that cost 6 or more @term(time) gain @kw(pierce).

beaconrunner_spurs.name: Beaconrunner Spurs
beaconrunner_spurs.description: Each tile in your @term(illuminate) you enter during a @kw(move) refunds 1 @kw(movement), up to 2 each turn.

dawnstitch_cord.name: Dawnstitch Cord
dawnstitch_cord.description: The first card each turn that creates @icon(illuminate), grants @icon(vision) or @icon(truesight), or uses @icon(dispel_umbra) grants @icon(block) {0.reward0.amount}.

starless_astrolabe.name: Starless Astrolabe
starless_astrolabe.description: While you have @icon(truesight), applying @icon(freeze) or @icon(shock) creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} beneath that enemy.

witchglass_carapace.name: Witchglass Carapace
witchglass_carapace.description: Enemy @kw(ranged) attacks deal at most 1 damage to your @term(illusion|Illusions).

witchglass_lantern.name: Witchglass Lantern
witchglass_lantern.description: Your @icon(illusion) have +{radius} @icon(illuminate) radius while they last.

sunlit_edge.name: Sunlit Edge
sunlit_edge.description: While you stand in @term(illuminate), your attacks gain @kw(pierce).

glassway_compass.name: Glassway Compass
glassway_compass.description: Your @kw(move) and @kw(blink) can end on one of your @term(illusion|Illusions) to @kw(swap) with it, skipping the tiles between.

unclouded_sun.name: Unclouded Sun
unclouded_sun.description: When you @kw(move), the centers of your @term(illuminate|Lights) count as next to each other.

ashen_brand.name: Ashen Brand
ashen_brand.description: Your @kw(detonate) @kw(surface_consume|Expends) all connected @term(surface_fire). A target hit by several blast crosses takes 25% more damage per extra cross.

winters_spur.name: Winter's Spur
winters_spur.description: Each straight line of @term(surface_ice) you move across costs only 1 @kw(movement). Turning starts a new line.

resonant_clapper.name: Resonant Clapper
resonant_clapper.description: Your @kw(chain) deals 25% more damage per enemy it already hit. Empty relays and conduction-only hits neither count nor gain this bonus.

galehook_talon.name: Galehook Talon
galehook_talon.description: Your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) move the target together with every enemy touching it in a line along that direction. Only the front one collides.

cragbound_gauntlet.name: Cragbound Gauntlet
cragbound_gauntlet.description: Your @kw(element_earth) @kw(ranged) attacks and @kw(aoe|Area Attacks) also raise a 3-@term(health) @kw(outcrop) on an empty floor target.

procession_lantern.name: Procession Lantern
procession_lantern.description: Your @term(illusion|Illusions) can move by spending your @kw(movement).

crowncoal_heart.name: Crowncoal Heart
crowncoal_heart.description: Once per turn, your single-target hit on a tile without @term(surface_fire), @term(surface_ice) or @term(surface_electrified) places @kw(surface_fire). @kw(detonate|Detonating) 2+ @kw(surface_fire) grants 6 @term(stoneskin), once per turn.

worldheart.name: Worldheart
worldheart.description: At the end of your turn, up to 2 @term(block) becomes @term(stoneskin). Gaining @kw(stoneskin) deals half, rounded down, to enemies next to you, max 4.

unbound_pinion.name: Unbound Pinion
unbound_pinion.description: Once per turn, when your @kw(push) or @kw(pull) moves an enemy 2 or more tiles or makes it collide, refill your @kw(movement) and @kw(draw) 1.

winters_hour.name: Winter's Hourglass
winters_hour.description: Your first @kw(element_ice) card each turn refills a 3-@term(time) store that lasts all combat. Other cards spend it to cost less, down to 1.

stormroad_coil.name: Stormroad Coil
stormroad_coil.description: Your single-target @kw(ranged) attacks can relay once through an @term(surface_electrified) tile, with normal @kw(range) on each leg.

eclipse_mantle.name: Eclipse Mantle
eclipse_mantle.description: Your first @kw(blink) each turn leaves a 2-@term(health) @term(illusion) where you started. Your @kw(illusion|Illusions) shed radius-2 @term(illuminate).

recoil_plates.name: Recoil Plates
recoil_plates.description: You take 1 @kw(collision) damage per lost tile instead of 2. Whenever you are part of a @kw(collision), gain 3 @term(block).

millstone_fob.name: Millstone Fob
millstone_fob.description: When an enemy you @kw(push) or @kw(pull) collides, the tile it stopped on becomes @term(surface_rubble).

tallow_candle.name: Tallow Candle
tallow_candle.description: At the start of combat, create radius-2 @term(illuminate) on your tile for 3 turns.

pocket_sundial.name: Pocket Sundial
pocket_sundial.description: If your turn ends with no @kw(wait), your next turn comes 2 @term(time) sooner.

leaden_pommel.name: Leaden Pommel
leaden_pommel.description: Attacks on cards that cost 5 or more @term(time) gain +1 @kw(stagger).

pitch_gloves.name: Pitch Gloves
pitch_gloves.description: @term(surface_fire) deals you 1 less damage. @kw(surface_fire) you create deals enemies 1 more.

hobnail_cleats.name: Hobnail Cleats
hobnail_cleats.description: @term(surface_ice) doesn't make you @term(chilled). While you stand on @term(surface_ice), your @term(element_ice) attacks deal 2 more damage.

grounding_pin.name: Grounding Pin
grounding_pin.description: Your single-target attacks against enemies on @term(surface_electrified) gain +1 @kw(chain).

rubblewalker_greaves.name: Rubblewalker Greaves
rubblewalker_greaves.description: @term(surface_rubble) doesn't slow you. At the start of your turn, if you stand on @kw(surface_rubble), gain 1 @term(stoneskin).

grave_dirt.name: Grave Dirt
grave_dirt.description: At the start of combat, gain 4 @term(stoneskin).

waxen_effigy.name: Waxen Effigy
waxen_effigy.description: At the start of combat, create a 2-@term(health) @term(illusion) on the empty tile next to you nearest an enemy.

quick_draw_bandolier.name: Quick-Draw Bandolier
quick_draw_bandolier.description: Your @kw(item|Items) don't use a @term(card_play), but cost 1 more @term(time).

briar_vambrace.name: Briar Vambrace
briar_vambrace.description: When a card gives you @term(block), also gain @kw(retaliate) 1, once per card.

fencers_gloves.name: Fencer's Gloves
fencers_gloves.description: Your second card each turn costs 1 less @term(time).

feint_ribbon.name: Feint Ribbon
feint_ribbon.description: If you've traveled 2 or more tiles this turn, your first card counts as a @kw(follow_up).

battering_yoke.name: Battering Yoke
battering_yoke.description: When your @kw(push) or @kw(pull) slams an enemy into another, that one is knocked 1 tile the same way and can collide too.

pendulum_weight.name: Pendulum Weight
pendulum_weight.description: @kw(stagger) beyond an enemy's per-turn limit is dealt to it as damage instead.

martyrs_gorget.name: Martyr's Gorget
martyrs_gorget.description: When your @kw(retaliate) damages an attacker, gain that much @term(block).

reliquary_box.name: Reliquary Box
reliquary_box.description: Your opening hand includes a @kw(rite) from your deck, if you have one. Each @kw(rite) costs 1 less @term(time).

changelings_rattle.name: Changeling's Rattle
changelings_rattle.description: When an enemy destroys your @term(illusion), that enemy suffers @kw(stagger) 3 and @term(expose) 2.

copper_shod_staff.name: Copper-Shod Staff
copper_shod_staff.description: For your @kw(element_lightning), your @kw(outcrop|Outcrops) and @term(illusion|Illusions) count as @term(surface_electrified) and take no damage from it.

ashen_phylactery.name: Ashen Phylactery
ashen_phylactery.description: When you @kw(exhaust) a non-@kw(item) card, gain @term(stoneskin) equal to the @term(time) you paid for it, up to 5.

bonded_set.name: Bonded Set
bonded_set.description: Cards from an equipment piece that shares its element with another equipped piece deal 1 more damage and grant 1 more @term(block).

masons_plumb.name: Mason's Plumb
masons_plumb.description: Your @kw(outcrop|Outcrops) have 2 more @term(health). An enemy that collides with one of your @kw(outcrop|Outcrops) takes 2 more damage, and the @kw(outcrop) takes none.

breaking_wheel.name: The Breaking Wheel
breaking_wheel.description: When an enemy collides on ground, @kw(surface_consume) it. @term(surface_fire): 3 more damage. @term(surface_ice): @term(freeze). @term(surface_electrified): @term(shock) it and enemy blockers. @term(surface_rubble): @kw(stagger) 3.

hollow_puppet.name: Hollow Puppet
hollow_puppet.description: Your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) can target your @term(illusion|Illusions) harmlessly. An @kw(illusion) that collides with an enemy shatters and deals its remaining @term(health) to it instead.

toll_late_bell.name: Toll of the Late Bell
toll_late_bell.description: Enemies set to act after your next turn on the @kw(turn_clock) are late: your attacks deal them 3 more damage.

rosary_of_vows.name: Rosary of Vows
rosary_of_vows.description: At the start of your turn, gain 2 @term(block) for each active @kw(rite) you have.

siege_ram_totem.name: Siege Ram Totem
siege_ram_totem.description: When an enemy takes @kw(collision) damage, it also suffers that much @kw(stagger).

echoing_blade.name: Echoing Blade
echoing_blade.description: When a @kw(follow_up) bonus applies, @kw(quicken) 1. Your next card this turn deals 2 more damage.

alchemists_retort.name: Alchemist's Retort
alchemists_retort.description: Your @kw(item|Items)' damage, @term(block), @kw(heal) and @term(stoneskin) are increased by half, rounded up.

crown_of_surplus.name: Crown of Surplus
crown_of_surplus.description: Cards without @kw(empower) gain one: pay 3 @term(time) to repeat the card's first action. @kw(rite|Rites), @kw(item|Items) and @kw(flurry) cards are excluded.

mirror_triptych.name: Mirror Triptych
mirror_triptych.description: Up to 3 @term(illusion|Illusions) repeat your first attack each turn for half damage, rounded down. Each hits the nearest reachable enemy and loses 1 @term(health).

pyre_keepers_urn.name: Pyre-Keeper's Urn
pyre_keepers_urn.description: At the start of your turn, return your last @kw(exhaust|Exhausted) card to your hand, unless it is a @kw(rite) or heals.

briar_throne.name: Briar Throne
briar_throne.description: Your @kw(retaliate) no longer expires, and grows by 1 each time it triggers. Cards can't give you @term(block).

whirling_sash.name: Whirling Sash
whirling_sash.description: Gain 1 extra @term(card_play) each turn. Each card after your second each turn costs 2 more @term(time).

quartermasters_ledger.name: Quartermaster's Ledger
quartermasters_ledger.description: Your @kw(item|Items) @kw(exhaust) instead of @kw(consume) unless they heal, so each can be used once per combat.
